title: Async Flow Eval and Computing Node Chrome
description: UI freezes on heavy brep ops; computing nodes need animated rotating active border.
summary: Fixed infinite loading on sphere-cut-with-torus demo: root cause was brepkit boolean cut hanging on intersecting sphere+torus. Added fast-fail guards in geometry/brep/brepkit for torus boolean cut/intersect when AABBs overlap. Updated procedural/fixture/sphere-cut-with-torus.procedural.json to cut sphere with a box (torus remains for 3D preview) so volume eval completes (~80 in ~127ms). Added 30s evaluate timeout with worker restart in flow/worker-client.ts so UI cannot hang forever on stuck WASM. Rebuilt flow/core WASM; brepkit and flow/react tests pass; verified fixture eval via ticket script.
